function wrapString<T extends string & {}>(value: T): T[] { return [value]; }
function wrapNumber<T extends number & {}>(value: T): {value: T} { return {value}; }
function wrapBigInt<T extends bigint & {}>(value: T): T[] { return [value]; }
function wrapPattern<T extends `item-${string}` & {}>(value: T): {value: T} { return {value}; }
function wrapMixed<T extends (string & {}) | number>(value: T): T[] { return [value]; }
function wrapConditional<U, T extends U extends boolean ? string : number>(value: T, condition: U): {value: T} {
  return {value};
}

const strings = wrapString('text');
const numbers = wrapNumber(7);
const bigInts = wrapBigInt(9n);
const patterns = wrapPattern('item-a');
const mixed = wrapMixed('mixed');
const conditional = wrapConditional('literal', true);
const text: 'text' = strings[0];
const seven: 7 = numbers.value;
const nine: 9n = bigInts[0];
const pattern: 'item-a' = patterns.value;
const keptMixed: 'mixed' = mixed[0];
const keptConditional: 'literal' = conditional.value;
console.log(text, seven, nine, pattern, keptMixed, keptConditional);
